FrequencyRange.description: Frequency range with lower and upper limits

StokesParameters.description: Stokes parameters, representing different aspects of polarization

U.description: Another linear polarization, orthogonal to Q

Band.description: Table representing a frequency band with a name and frequency range

DATA_MODE.description: Mode of the data (real, simulated, synthetic)

POWER_TYPE.description: Type of power (eg. AC or DC)

TRANSMIT.description: Indicates if the EMT can transmit

RECEIVE.description: Indicates if the EMT can receive

TASKABLE.description: Indicates if the site is taskable

SOURCE_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier of the source in the provider's
registry of sources.

SOURCE_KIND.description: What kind of data the source supplies.

ORIGINATOR.description:
Agency, operator or catalog that created the source data, as it names
itself. Not a message's CCSDS ORIGINATOR, which names who created the
message.

PROVIDER_ID.description:
Identifier of the provider that published the product, as the provider
names itself: the module, node or service that retrieved the source data.

PRODUCER.description:
Identifier of the software that made the product from the source data,
with its version when it has one.

LICENSE_CLASS.description: What the source's terms permit for the product.

LICENSE_ID.description:
Identifier of the terms LICENSE_CLASS was read from: an SPDX license
identifier where one applies, else the identifier of the terms in the
provider's licence register.

LINEAGE.description:
Identifier of the lineage the source's data descends from. Sources that
republish one upstream share its lineage, so their products are not
independent of each other.

RFMOrigin.description:
The point a coordinate system is centred on. Body and barycentre
identifiers are integer ephemeris body codes; text NAME is descriptive
only and is never the machine key.

CELESTIAL_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code when KIND is CELESTIAL_BODY.

BARYCENTRE_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the barycentre when KIND is BARYCENTRE.

LIBRATION_POINT.description: Which libration point, when KIND is LIBRATION_POINT.

LIBRATION_PRIMARY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the libration system primary.

LIBRATION_SECONDARY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the libration system secondary.

OBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the space object when KIND is SPACE_OBJECT.

SITE_ID.description: Identifier of the surface site when KIND is GROUND_SITE.

SITE_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the body the site sits on.

SITE_LATITUDE.description: Geodetic latitude of the site, degrees, positive north.

SITE_LONGITUDE.description: Geodetic longitude of the site, degrees, positive east.

SITE_ALTITUDE.description: Height of the site above the reference ellipsoid, metres.

RFMObjectReferencedAxes.description:
Axes built from the relative geometry of two objects. Exactly two of the
three axis assignments are independent; the third completes the triad.

RFMLocalAlignedConstrainedAxes.description:
Axes built by aligning one vector with a reference direction and using a
second vector as a constraint. Vectors are 3-element, expressed in the
coordinate system named by REFERENCE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.

RFMCoordinateSystem.description:
A fully specified coordinate system: an axis set, an origin, and the epoch
and time system the axis set is evaluated at. This is the unit a frames
consumer needs; the pre-existing RFMUnion members name an axis convention
alone and cannot express an origin.

NAME.description: Stable name for this coordinate system within the producing data set.

AXIS_REFERENCE_BODY_ID.description:
Ephemeris body code whose equator/rotation defines the axes, for the
body-referenced axis types. Independent of ORIGIN.

EPOCH.description:
Reference epoch the axis set is evaluated at, ISO 8601. Required for the
of-date and of-epoch axis types; ignored by the inertial ones.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time system the EPOCH is expressed in, named by the $TIM timingStandard
member name (for example "UTC", "TAI", "TT", "TDB", "A1").

KERNEL_FRAME_NAME.description: Kernel-declared frame name for EPHEMERIS_KERNEL_DEFINED axes.

KERNEL_FRAME_ID.description: Kernel-declared numeric frame id for EPHEMERIS_KERNEL_DEFINED axes.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set used to realise
this system, when the axis chain requires one. Recorded so that two
consumers can prove they used the same table rather than assume it.

GALCEN_RA_DEG.description:
ICRS right ascension of the Galactic center, degrees. NaN means absent.
Sgr A*: 17h45m40.0409s (Reid & Brunthaler 2004, ApJ 616, 872).

GALCEN_DEC_DEG.description:
ICRS declination of the Galactic center, degrees. NaN means absent.
Sgr A*: -29d00m28.118s (Reid & Brunthaler 2004, ApJ 616, 872).

GALCEN_DISTANCE_PC.description:
Sun-to-Galactic-center distance R0, parsecs. NaN means absent.
Example: 8178 pc (GRAVITY Collaboration 2019, A&A 625, L10).

Z_SUN_PC.description:
Solar height above the Galactic midplane, parsecs, positive north.
NaN means absent; example: 20.8 pc (Bennett & Bovy 2019, MNRAS 482, 1417).

ROLL_DEG.description:
Roll angle in degrees in the Astropy Galactocentric convention.
NaN means absent, not zero. With GALACTIC axes, the five explicit scalar
parameters define a derived Galactocentric orientation: X points from
the Sun toward the center's projection in the midplane, Y follows
Galactic rotation, and Z completes a right-handed triad toward Galactic
north. This parameterized orientation is independent of ORIGIN; with
GALACTIC_CENTER the Sun lies at X=-sqrt(R0^2-Z_SUN_PC^2), Y=0, Z=Z_SUN_PC.
All five scalars must be finite for a spatial Galactocentric transform,
with R0 > 0 and abs(Z_SUN_PC) <= R0; none has an assumed default.

V_SUN_KMS.description:
Total solar velocity [v_X,v_Y,v_Z] in km/s in the resulting Galactocentric
axes, including circular motion (not just peculiar U,V,W). Exactly three
components when present; omit the vector when unknown, or use NaN for
an unknown component. A velocity transform requires all three finite.
Schonrich, Binney & Dehnen (2010), MNRAS 403, 1829, constrain peculiar
motion; Reid & Brunthaler (2020), ApJ 892, 39, constrain Sgr A* motion.
Publishers must state their adopted total velocity; no default is implied.

SITCitation.description:
Where one statement about a site was read: the source, the record, the
version of the record and the field the statement came from.

PROVENANCE.description: The source, its originator and the terms the statement travels under

SOURCE_RECORD_ID.description:
The source's own identifier of the record (Wikidata QID, "de:Article
title", tracker unit ids, ROR id, docket number, register row)

SOURCE_URL.description: Where the record can be read

SOURCE_VERSION.description: The source's version of the record (revision id, release name)

SOURCE_FIELD.description:
The field of the record the statement was read from, from a closed
vocabulary: a Wikidata property ("P5817", "P576"), "infobox:<parameter>",
"description", "class:<QID>", "status" (a registry's status column),
"units" (a tracker's unit statuses), "register:<id>" (a row of the
provider's reviewed register). Never free text.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: When the record was read, RFC 3339 UTC

SITStatusEvidence.description: One source's assertion of one lifecycle step of a site.

STATUS_DATE.description: When that status took effect, ISO 8601 at the source's precision (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD)

SITReference.description: A reference to another record about the site or a party.

REGISTRY.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier of the registry in the provider's
register of sources (wikidata, geonames, enwiki, gem-gnpt, ror, us-nrc)

RECORD_ID.description: The registry's identifier of the record

URL.description: Where the record can be read

TITLE.description:
The record's title as the registry states it (for an encyclopedia, the
article title only, never its text)

SITParty.description: An organisation with a part at the site.

NAME.description: Its name, as the source states it

EXTERNAL_REFERENCES.description: Records about the party (its registry record, its official website)

CITATION.description: Where the statement that it plays this part was read

SITQuantity.description: One stated quantity of a site.

UNITS.description: Units, CCSDS NDM spelling (MW, m); empty for a count

DATE.description: When the value applies, ISO 8601 at the source's precision; empty when the source states none

Geometry.description: Geometry table with information about geometric properties

ID.description: Unique identifier for the site, BE_NUMBER

SITE_TYPE.description: Site type as defined in SiteType enum

LATITUDE.description:
Latitude of the site, degrees; planetocentric on CENTER_NAME's reference
body when that is not EARTH

LONGITUDE.description: Longitude of the site, degrees, east positive

ALTITUDE.description: Altitude of the site above CENTER_NAME's reference surface

CTR_ID.description: CTR ISO 3166 Numeric code as string

CREATED_BY.description: Identifier of the user who created the site data

MODEL_URL.description: URL for the 3D model of the site

TASKABLE.description: Indicates if the site is taskable

OPERATIONAL_STATUS.description: Operational status of the site (e.g., active, inactive, under construction)

LIFECYCLE_STATUS.description:
Where the site stands in its life. OPERATIONAL_STATUS keeps availability
words (Online, Offline, Testing); this field is the lifecycle.

LIFECYCLE_STATUS_DATE.description: When LIFECYCLE_STATUS took effect, ISO 8601 at the source's precision

STATUS_VERIFIED_AT.description: When the status was last checked against its sources, RFC 3339 UTC

STATUS_EVIDENCE.description: Each source's assertion behind LIFECYCLE_STATUS, one per source and step

SITE_KIND.description:
What kind of site this is, as its source names the class ("research
reactor", "radioactive waste repository"); SITE_TYPE is the nearest
SiteType

DESCRIPTION_CITATION.description: Where DESCRIPTION was read; a DESCRIPTION without one is the publisher's own

POSITION_CITATION.description: Where LATITUDE, LONGITUDE (and ALTITUDE) were read

EXTERNAL_REFERENCES.description:
Records about the site in other registers; the RECORD role names the
site's own record

PROVENANCE.description:
The record's provider and producer, and the terms of the content the
record reproduces (each citation carries its own source's terms)

CENTER_NAME.description:
The body the site stands on, spelled as the CCSDS ODM/OMM CENTER_NAME
keyword (SANA celestial body registry: EARTH, MOON, MARS). Absent means
EARTH, so every site published before 1.2.0 reads unchanged.

REFERENCE_FRAME.description:
The body-fixed frame LATITUDE and LONGITUDE are expressed in, as an
RFMCoordinateSystem of AXIS_TYPE EPHEMERIS_KERNEL_DEFINED whose
KERNEL_FRAME_NAME names the kernel frame (IAU_MOON, MOON_ME). Absent
means the Earth-fixed frame of EARTH, or the body's IAU body-fixed frame.

MISSION.description:
The mission the site belongs to (Apollo 11, Chandrayaan-3), as its
source names it. Empty for a site of no mission.

EVENT_EPOCH.description:
When the landing or impact took place, RFC 3339 UTC; for a
LANDING_SITE or IMPACT_SITE only. Empty when the source states none.

CryptoKey.description:
Represents cryptographic key information.

The publication paradigm is "literal public keys, not derivation
material": a published EPM carries the PUBLIC_KEY bytes that verify
the record's SIGNATURE (signing) or encrypt to the entity (encryption),
and NOTHING about how those keys were derived. XPUB, KEY_PATH and
KEY_ADDRESS are PRIVATE / operational — they belong to the wallet that
produced the keys, never to the record a peer resolves.

Requiredness is PROFILE-ENFORCED, never a flatc `(required)` attribute:
a `(required)` on PUBLIC_KEY would make the flatbuffers Verifier reject
every pre-flip secp256k1 record that legitimately omitted it (the
2026-07-27 dual-curve regime allowed xpub-derivation for secp at
non-hardened paths). A published record is self-describing instead —
PUBLIC_KEY present, XPUB/KEY_PATH/KEY_ADDRESS absent — and a conformance
checker asserts that profile (see scripts/check-epm-published-profile.mjs).

Rotation is by republish: a new signing or encryption key means a new
PUBLIC_KEY, a re-signed SIGNATURE, and a re-published EPM at the same
peer-addressed location. The PeerID (multihash of the libp2p identity
pubkey) is the stable anchor across rotations.

PUBLIC_KEY.description:
Public part of the cryptographic key, in hexadecimal format. AUTHORITATIVE
in a published record: this is the verifying/encrypting key, and no other
field yields it. Required-in-practice (profile-enforced, not flatc
`(required)`) so that pre-flip secp256k1 records without it still decode.

XPUB.description:
Extended public key, as specified by BIP-32 (hierarchical deterministic
wallets), "Extended keys". PRIVATE / operational: present only in the
wallet that derived the keys, ABSENT from published records. A verifier
never derives a child key from XPUB — the PUBLIC_KEY is the verification
material.

PRIVATE_KEY.description: Private part of the cryptographic key in hexidecimal format, should be kept secret

XPRIV.description: Extended private key, as specified by BIP-32 (hierarchical deterministic wallets), "Extended keys".

KEY_ADDRESS.description:
Address generated from the cryptographic key. PRIVATE / operational in a
published EPM: a chain address is bound through a ChainProof attestation,
not carried as a standalone KEY_ADDRESS on the CryptoKey. ABSENT from
published records.

ADDRESS_TYPE.description:
Type of the address generated from the cryptographic key. An address
format tag only — NOT a curve or algorithm designator; the algorithm
lives in ALGORITHM

KEY_TYPE.description: Type of the cryptographic key (signing or encryption)

KEY_PATH.description:
BIP-32 / SLIP-10 derivation path of this key from the entity root
(e.g., "m/44'/0'/0'/0/0" secp256k1 non-hardened, "m/44'/0'/0'/0'/0'"
ed25519 hardened). PRIVATE / operational: how the key was derived belongs
to the wallet, not to a published record. ABSENT from published records.

ALGORITHM.description:
Key algorithm/curve (e.g., "ed25519", "secp256k1"). ABSENT means
ed25519: every record published before this field existed verifies
unchanged under that default. The verifier dispatches on ALGORITHM (not
on ADDRESS_TYPE, which is an address-format tag only).

ENCODING.description:
Signature encoding format produced by this key (e.g., "raw-ed25519",
"der"). ABSENT means the canonical encoding of ALGORITHM: raw-ed25519
for ed25519 (64 bytes over the content itself); der for secp256k1, a
strict DER ECDSA signature over ONE SHA-256 of the canonical signing
content (CANONICAL_SERIALIZATION.md section 4). The signer passes the
content to a hashing signer, or its single SHA-256 to a digest signer,
never a digest to a hashing signer: ECDSA over SHA-256(SHA-256(content))
does not verify. "compact" (65-byte header||r||s) is a ChainProof
encoding only, never the EPM signature's

REGION.description: Region of the address (e.g., state or province)

LOCALITY.description: Locality of the address (e.g., city or town)

ChainProof.description: Proves a blockchain key derives from the same HD wallet as the signing key

SIGNATURE.description:
Signature over the attestation payload (hex-encoded), in the chain's
own signed-message form (see ALGORITHM)

SIGNED_PAYLOAD.description: The canonical payload that was signed (hex-encoded)

ALGORITHM.description:
Signature algorithm, which fixes the one hash the signature is over:
"secp256k1-compact-bitcoin": the Bitcoin signed-message hash
SHA-256(SHA-256("\x18Bitcoin Signed Message:\n" || CompactSize(len)
|| SIGNED_PAYLOAD)), as Bitcoin Core's signmessage signs it (the
double SHA-256 is the protocol's own, applied once);
"secp256k1-compact-ethereum": the EIP-191 personal_sign hash
Keccak-256("\x19Ethereum Signed Message:\n" || decimal(len) ||
SIGNED_PAYLOAD), low-S;
"ed25519": raw Ed25519 over SIGNED_PAYLOAD itself.
Both secp256k1 forms are the 65-byte compact recoverable signature
header||r||s (header 27 + recovery id, +4 for a compressed key; signers
emit 31 + recovery id). A verifier hashes SIGNED_PAYLOAD with the chain's
protocol, recovers the key and compares it with PUBLIC_KEY (33-byte
compressed). Nothing hashes the payload before the protocol hash.

ENCODING.description:
Signature encoding format: "compact" for the secp256k1 algorithms
(65-byte header||r||s), "raw-ed25519" for ed25519

DomainProof.description:
Proves control of a DNS domain by the same HD wallet as the signing key —
the EPM-record mirror of the DNS TXT wire form (which is deliberately
NON-SDS: a base64 FlatBuffer would not fit a 255-byte TXT record). The
canonical statement is 6 fixed LF-terminated lines prefixed
"sdn-domain-proof/1", and it verifies by BYTE-REPLAY of the verbatim
SIGNED_PAYLOAD (ChainProof precedent) — never by JCS.

DNS_DOMAIN.description:
Fully-qualified domain name the proof binds (e.g., "node.example.org").
Named DNS_DOMAIN because libc's <math.h> defines a DOMAIN macro, which
breaks the generated C++ accessor of a field named DOMAIN.

KEY_PATH.description:
BIP-32 / SLIP-10 derivation path of the proving key. The signer is the
Ed25519 EPM/publication key at m/44'/0'/0'/0'/0'

SIGNED_PAYLOAD.description: The canonical payload that was signed, verbatim (hex-encoded)

ENCODING.description:
Signature encoding format. ABSENT means the canonical encoding of
ALGORITHM (raw-ed25519 for ed25519)

LEGAL_NAME.description: Common name of the entity (person or organization)

FAMILY_NAME.description: Family name or surname of the person

GIVEN_NAME.description: Given name or first name of the person

ADDITIONAL_NAME.description: Additional name or middle name of the person

HONORIFIC_PREFIX.description: Honorific prefix preceding the person's name (e.g., Mr., Dr.)

HONORIFIC_SUFFIX.description: Honorific suffix following the person's name (e.g., Jr., Sr.)

KEYS.description: Cryptographic keys associated with the entity

MULTIFORMAT_ADDRESS.description: Multiformat addresses associated with the entity

SIGNATURE.description:
Signature over canonical EPM content (hex), produced by the entity's
signing key under the algorithm declared in SIGNATURE_ALGORITHM
(absent declaration = Ed25519)

SIGNATURE_TIMESTAMP.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the EPM was signed

CHAIN_PROOFS.description: Chain binding proofs linking blockchain keys to the same HD wallet

ENTITY_TYPE.description: Type of entity represented by this profile

SIGNATURE_ALGORITHM.description:
Signature algorithm that produced SIGNATURE (e.g., "ed25519",
"secp256k1"). ABSENT means ed25519 — this single default is what keeps
every EPM signed before this field existed verifying unchanged, so the
field MUST NOT be made required. The signing key is the first CryptoKey
in KEYS with KEY_TYPE Signing whose ALGORITHM matches this declaration
(an absent CryptoKey.ALGORITHM likewise means ed25519)

DOMAIN_PROOFS.description:
DNS domain binding proofs linking domains to the same HD wallet —
symmetric with CHAIN_PROOFS

PHOTO.description:
Photo or logo of the entity (the vCard PHOTO property), as an RFC 2397
data URI carrying a JPEG or PNG image, e.g.
"data:image/jpeg;base64,/9j/4AAQ…". Every peer that resolves the entity
fetches the record, so a producer keeps the image small (a few tens of
kilobytes at most). Signed like every other content field: it
participates in the canonical preimage (CANONICAL_SERIALIZATION.md)

NAME.description: Display name of the owner or source the code stands for.

DESCRIPTION.description: Longer description of the owner or source.

ACTIVE.description: True while the code is in current use by the publishing catalogue.

SOURCE_URL.description: URL of the reference table the row was retrieved from.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: ISO 8601 UTC time the reference table was retrieved.

CATProduct.description: One product the catalog selected for the object, by content identifier.

RECORD_CID.description:
CIDv1 of the product record: a multihash (SHA-256) of its exact bytes as
published, a size-prefixed FlatBuffer.

SOURCE_ID.description: The product's source: its PROVENANCE SOURCE_ID.

EPOCH.description:
Epoch of the product, ISO 8601 UTC: an $OMM's EPOCH, an $OCM's first state
epoch.

SELECTION_REASON.description:
Why the catalog selected this product over the other candidates of its
KIND, as the selecting integrator states it (for example, the lowest
measured median error for the object's orbit regime and prediction
horizon).

STALE.description:
True when a maneuver after EPOCH retired the product and no product of its
KIND from after the maneuver has been selected yet.

OBJECT_TYPE.description: Object type (Payload, Rocket body, Debris, Unknown)

RCS.description: Radar Cross Section [meters2]; blank if no data available

ORBIT_TYPE.description: Orbit type (Orbit, Landing, Impact, Docked to RSO, roundtrip)

MANEUVERABLE.description: Indicates if the object is maneuverable

SIZE.description: Size [meters]; blank if no data available

MASS.description: Mass [kilograms]; blank if no data available

BUS_ID.description:
Join key to the BUS record describing this object's satellite bus; holds
that record's BUS.ID verbatim. MANUFACTURER, DIM_X/DIM_Y/DIM_Z, DRY_MASS
and WET_MASS are properties of the bus design and live on BUS — they are
NOT duplicated here. Empty when the bus is unknown.

CATALOG_URI.description:
Absolute URI identifying the original catalog's object-ID namespace.
This is an identifier, not an instruction to fetch a resource. Use with
CATALOG_OBJECT_ID only when both fields are present. Preserve the pair
through replicas and derived catalogs; it does not assert a NORAD or
COSPAR association. If the authority can reassign an object ID, this URI
must identify its immutable edition or assignment interval, rather than
the unversioned catalog. Stable IDs may use a persistent catalog URI.

CATALOG_OBJECT_ID.description:
Exact, opaque object identifier assigned by CATALOG_URI's authority.
Preserve case, Unicode and leading zeros. Numeric-looking native IDs
are not NORAD_CAT_ID values. Neither a matching name nor a native ID
in a different namespace establishes that two records describe the same
physical object. Publication provenance retains source and edition data.

PRODUCTS.description:
The products an integrating catalog selected for the object as of
PRODUCTS_AS_OF: one $OMM per mean-element theory, each with the $OCM of
the same source and epoch where there is one. The object's maneuvers are
its $MNV stream, not references here.

PRODUCTS_AS_OF.description: ISO 8601 UTC instant the selection in PRODUCTS holds at.

FUEL_TYPE.description: Fuel Type Used in This Stage

THRUST.description: Thrust Produced by This Stage (in Newtons)
Thrust Produced by the Sustainer (in Newtons)
Thrust Produced by the Engine (in Newtons)

BOV.description:
Burn Out Vector Message: the state of a launch vehicle at burnout, in EFG
(Earth-fixed) coordinates. Position is in kilometers (km), velocity in
kilometers per second (km/s) and time in seconds (s); a producer holding
another unit converts before writing.

E_COORDINATE.description: EFG position, E component, km (11 significant figures).

F_COORDINATE.description: EFG position, F component, km (11 significant figures).

G_COORDINATE.description: EFG position, G component, km (11 significant figures).

E_DOT.description: EFG velocity, E component, km/s (9 significant figures).

F_DOT.description: EFG velocity, F component, km/s (9 significant figures).

G_DOT.description: EFG velocity, G component, km/s (9 significant figures).

EPOCH.description: Epoch time, in ISO 8601 UTC format.

TIME_FROM_LAUNCH.description: Time from launch, seconds (s), with appropriate precision.

OPERATIONS_POINTS_OF_CONTACT.description: Operations Points of Contact for Launch

MISSION_TYPE.description: Type of the Mission (e.g., Test Flight, Satellite Deployment)

WEATHER_CONDITIONS.description: Weather and Environmental Conditions at Launch

LAUNCH_STATUS.description: Launch Outcome and Status (e.g., Successful, Failed)

MEDIA_LINKS.description: Media Links Related to the Launch

COLA_SCREEN_DURATION.description: Duration of Collision Avoidance Screen (in Seconds)

COLA_RUNS_REQUIRED.description: Number of Required Collision Avoidance Runs

COLA_POINTS_OF_CONTACT.description: Points of Contact for Collision Avoidance

BURN_OUT_VECTORS.description: Burn Out Vectors for the Launch

ID.description:
APPENDED. Stable identifier of this launch in the registry that
published it; unchanged when the launch time or status changes.
